seats.name: single
argv:
The warehouse library in src/ must meet the specification in SPEC.md. The public tests in test/ pass today, but passing them does not prove the code meets the specification. Make the codebase conform to SPEC.md, keeping everything that already conforms working. Run the tests with: node --test test/*.test.ts. Do not create files outside this directory.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I fixed the code to match `SPEC.md`. The public tests still pass (5 pass, 0 fail). I didn't add tests for the new behaviour, so the fixes below are untested.

- **`src/inventory.ts`**
  - Receiving into an existing lot id now adds to its quantity instead of replacing it.
  - Available stock now ignores expired lots.
  - Lots with the same expiry are now used in ascending id order (the sort was reversed).
- **`src/orders.ts`**
  - Repeated skus in an order's lines are now summed before reserving.
  - A failed reservation now releases everything it had held. Before, it only released part of it.
- **`src/backorder.ts`**: cancelled orders are skipped on retry and never reserved again. They stay in the queue, as the spec says nothing removes them.
- **`src/warehouse.ts`**
  - Shipping is now refused if it exceeds the units still reserved for that sku.
  - Cancelling releases only the units still reserved. It used to also release units that had already shipped.
  - Returned units going to a lot that expired before that day are now discarded. Before, it allowed one day too many.
